keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Lamine Sy (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Strasbourg 1, Auxerre 0. Dário Essugo (Strasbourg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Oso.
Second Half begins Strasbourg 1, Auxerre 0.
Goal! Strasbourg 2, Auxerre 0. Martial Godo (Strasbourg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Gessime Yassine following a fast break.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Sebastian Nanasi replaces Martial Godo.
Christ Makosso (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Strasbourg 3, Auxerre 0. Conrad Harder (Strasbourg) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
Substitution, Auxerre. Arthur Piedfort replaces Danny Namaso.
Substitution, Auxerre. Lamfia Dioubaté replaces Kévin Danois.
Substitution, Auxerre. Rayan Mandengue replaces Lamine Sy.
Substitution, Auxerre. Marvin Senaya replaces Christ Makosso.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Diogo Sousa replaces Giovanni Reyna.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Jeyland Mitchell replaces Ismaël Doukouré.
Goal! Strasbourg 3, Auxerre 1. Cameron Archer (Auxerre) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Romain Faivre with a headed pass.
Paul Nardi (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Auxerre. Youssef Khoudda replaces Naouirou Ahamada.
Lamfia Dioubaté (Auxerre) is shown the red card.
Goal! Strasbourg 4, Auxerre 1. Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Sebastian Nanasi.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Pape Diop replaces Dário Essugo.
Substitution, Strasbourg. Jacobo Ortega replaces Conrad Harder.
Goal! Strasbourg 5, Auxerre 1. Gessime Yassine (Strasbourg) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Oso with a cross.
Romain Faivre (Auxerre) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
